message:

The batch is now with you.
hold_reason: Refund for order 121 (5261 cents) failed after 3 attempts and was not recorded; refunds are incomplete.

reply.thought: Alpha reported that the refund for order 121 failed and was not recorded, so the batch’s refunds were not completed as intended. I’m holding the batch for human review before any payout is recorded.
